sponsored.t: Authorizes the city of New York to provide for a residential parking permit system in Queens Community Boards 3 and 4
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of New York to provide for a residential parking permit system in Queens Community Boards 3 and 4 to reduce hazards and pollution levels.

sponsored.t: Enacts the ceasing repeated and extremely egregious predatory (CREEP) behavior act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "ceasing repeated and extremely egregious predatory (CREEP) behavior act"; provides for the issuance of anti-stalking orders.

sponsored.t: Relates to detaining persons for longer than twenty-four hours
sponsored.sum: Relates to detaining persons for longer than twenty-four hours.

sponsored.t: Requires screening incarcerated individuals for eligibility for public benefits prior to release
sponsored.sum: Requires screening incarcerated individuals for eligibility for public benefits prior to release and assistance in applying for such programs; requires officials to seek waivers from the USDA for eligibility for such program.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the use of a confirmation of trafficking victim status as evidence of identity for the issuance of an identification card
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the use of a confirmation of trafficking victim status issued by OTDA as evidence of identity for the issuance of a non-driver identification card.

sponsored.t: Relates to the purchase of claims by corporations or collection agencies
sponsored.sum: Relates to the purchase of claims by corporations or collection agencies; relates to the inference of an assignee's intent and purpose in taking an assignment of a claim against an obligor that is not an eligible obligor.

sponsored.t: Relates to the composition of the interagency task force on human trafficking
sponsored.sum: Relates to the composition of the interagency task force on human trafficking and when such reports shall be submitted.

sponsored.t: Relates to granting employees access to personnel records
sponsored.sum: Grants employees access to personnel records; requires notice of negative information in such records and an opportunity for a review; permits employee to include certain information in personnel records.

sponsored.t: Relates to companion animals
sponsored.sum: Provides that companion animals, as sentient beings, shall be considered victims of animal cruelty crimes, including but not limited to all offenses as defined in article twenty-six of the agriculture and markets law, and shall be treated as such in a court of law.

sponsored.t: Designates unlawful discriminatory practices relating to persons recovering from substance use disorder
sponsored.sum: Relates to unlawful discriminatory practices by government agencies relating to persons recovering from substance use disorder.

sponsored.t: Relates to reporting requirements on small nonprofits
sponsored.sum: Relates to reporting requirements on small nonprofits which lobby before the government.

sponsored.t: Relates to the unauthorized or unlicensed practice of massage therapy
sponsored.sum: Provides that neither the unauthorized or unlicensed practice of massage therapy, nor aiding or abetting of unauthorized or unlicensed practice of massage therapy, shall be deemed as the crime of unauthorized practice.

sponsored.t: Relates to the Fair Fares act
sponsored.sum: Requires that any individual who is eligible for the Fair Fares NYC program and any person whose income is three hundred percent of the federal poverty level receive a fifty percent discount on trips using the Long Island Rail Road, paratransit services, New York city transit subways or buses, and/or Metro-North railroad; defines terms.

sponsored.t: Provides for minimum wage requirements for miscellaneous industry workers and establishes a one fair wage reimbursement credit
sponsored.sum: Provides for minimum wage requirements for miscellaneous industry workers; establishes a one fair wage reimbursement credit.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a gender-affirming care access program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a gender-affirming care access program to provide support and increase access to gender-affirming care including certain medical and surgical care.

sponsored.t: Relates to the reporting requirements of the statewide fiscal intermediary; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the reporting requirements of the statewide fiscal intermediary; requires the reporting of utilization data and financial data to protect medical assistance recipients in using the program and ensure the effective use of medical assistance funds; requires the statewide fiscal intermediary to provide consumer directed personal assistant data to ensure the availability of a workforce to meet the needs of consumers utilizing the program; requires the statewide fiscal intermediary to provide data regarding customer service requests, complaints, and accessibility.

sponsored.t: Relates to eligibility for the temporary assistance to needy families block grant program, safety net assistance and medical assistance for certain noncitizens
sponsored.sum: Relates to eligibility for the temporary assistance to needy families block grant program, safety net assistance and medical assistance for certain noncitizens.

sponsored.t: Relates to enforcement of provisions regarding regulation of tobacco products, herbal cigarettes, and smoking paraphernalia
sponsored.sum: Amends the effective date of a 2025 chapter relating to enforcement of provisions regarding regulation of tobacco products, herbal cigarettes, and smoking paraphernalia.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of the term "excited delirium" as a diagnosis, label, or cause of death
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of the term "excited delirium" as a diagnosis, label, or cause of death on death certificates, autopsy reports, police reports or any report, policy or procedure by a public agency or contractor; defines excited delirium.

sponsored.t: Enacts the overdose prevention and recovery act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the overdose prevention and recovery act; directs that at least twenty percent of funds from the opioid stewardship fund shall be invested in recovery services and supports; requires an annual report to the legislature regarding funds distributed from the opioid stewardship fund; makes the opioid stewardship fund permanent.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing universal school meals to students
sponsored.sum: Requires all public school districts, charter schools and non-public schools in the state that participate in the national school lunch program or school breakfast program as provided in the national child nutrition act to serve breakfast and lunch at no cost to the student.

sponsored.t: Directs payment of certain taxes into the central business district tolling capital lockbox fund to be made without appropriation
sponsored.sum: Directs payment of certain internet sales and use taxes into the central business district tolling capital lockbox fund partially dedicated for the MTA to be made without appropriation.

sponsored.t: Includes additional community districts in which pilot programs to address the legalization or conversion of certain basement and cellar dwellings can be established by local law
sponsored.sum: Includes additional community districts in which pilot programs to address the legalization or conversion of certain basement and cellar dwellings can be established by local law.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of education to develop school health and mental health professionals to student ratios in public schools
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of education to develop school health and mental health professionals to student ratios in public schools for students who do not receive services pursuant to the individuals with disabilities education act.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring that certain information be provided to operators of limited use motorcycles
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring that certain information be provided to operators of limited use motorcycles concerning rules of the road and consequences for non-compliance.

sponsored.t: Requires the implementation of an electronic benefit transfer system
sponsored.sum: Requires the implementation of an electronic benefit transfer system using industry-standard commercial electronic funds transfer technology.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain data required in an annual report on the administration of managed long term care plans
sponsored.sum: Requires certain data to be included in reports on the administration of managed long term care plans; changes reporting period to annually.

sponsored.t: Repeals the requirement that applicants must pass an examination in order to qualify as a licensed master social worker
sponsored.sum: Repeals the requirement that applicants must pass an examination in order to qualify as a licensed master social worker.

sponsored.t: Provides that certain communications made without malice regarding an incident of sexual assault, harassment or discrimination shall be deemed privileged
sponsored.sum: Provides that certain communications made without malice regarding an incident of sexual assault, harassment or discrimination shall be deemed privileged; provides that a prevailing defendant in an action brought against such defendant for making a communication that is privileged shall be entitled to attorney's fees and costs for such defense.

sponsored.t: Repeals section 2307 of the public health law relating to persons knowing themselves to be infected with venereal disease
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions relating to persons knowing themselves to be infected with venereal disease.

sponsored.t: Grants medical assistance eligibility for kidney transplant expenses for certain residents of New York
sponsored.sum: Grants medical assistance eligibility for kidney transplant expenses for residents of New York with end-stage renal disease who are otherwise eligible for benefits except for their immigration status.

sponsored.t: Establishes a state SNAP minimum benefit program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a state SNAP minimum benefit program to provide a minimum amount of supplemental nutrition assistance program benefits that is higher than the amount of federal SNAP benefits.

sponsored.t: Permits midwives and physician assistants to certify the cause of death on a fetal death certificate
sponsored.sum: Permits midwives and physician assistants to certify the cause of death on a fetal death certificate if they are in attendance at or after a fetal death.

sponsored.t: Establishes security deposit options for certain tenants
sponsored.sum: Establishes security deposit options for certain tenants, including but not limited to, an option to pay any deposit or advance to rent or use residential real property or a dwelling unit.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting any substituted consent for a sterilization procedure
sponsored.sum: Provides that substituted consent by a guardian, health care proxy, or other third party shall not authorize a procedure resulting in sterilization in the absence of the informed consent of the person being sterilized.

sponsored.t: Provides for coverage for certain individuals under the 1332 state innovation program
sponsored.sum: Provides for coverage for certain individuals under the 1332 state innovation program.

sponsored.t: Provides practical support for access to abortion care
sponsored.sum: Provides practical support for access to abortion care including, but not limited to, reimbursement for ground and air transportation, lodging, meals, childcare, translation services, and doula support.

sponsored.t: Relates to expanding the health department's review of correctional health services
sponsored.sum: Expands the health department's review of correctional health services by including a biennial study of health care staffing at facilities operated by the department of corrections and community supervision.

sponsored.t: Eliminates asset limits in calculating the amount of benefits for any household under any public assistance program
sponsored.sum: Relates to eliminating asset limits in calculating the amount of benefits for any household under any public assistance program.

sponsored.t: Establishes a COVID-19 pandemic response study commission
sponsored.sum: Establishes the COVID-19 pandemic response study commission to conduct a study of the state's response to the COVID-19 pandemic; provides for the repeal of such commission upon the completion of the commission's final report.

sponsored.t: Includes middle eastern and north African persons in the definition of minority group member for purposes of participation by minority group members and women with respect to state contracts
sponsored.sum: Includes middle Eastern and North African persons in the definition of "minority group member" for purposes of participation by minority group members and women with respect to state contracts.

sponsored.t: Relates to the amount of state aid reimbursement for public health services by a municipality in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Relates to the amount of state aid reimbursement for public health services by a municipality in the city of New York when the municipality is providing some or all of certain identified core public health services.

sponsored.t: Relates to cost sharing fees for outpatient treatment at a substance use treatment program
sponsored.sum: Provides that for a substance use disorder outpatient treatment episode of care by a provider licensed, certified or otherwise authorized by the office of addiction services and supports, an insured shall only be responsible for a cost sharing fee not to exceed two hundred fifty dollars.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a sex trafficking awareness and prevention program
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of DMV to establish a sex trafficking awareness and prevention program to provide education and awareness literature and educational materials to trade schools, community colleges, agencies, public or private schools or persons offering instruction in the operation of commercial motor vehicles with a commercial motor vehicle license and requires applicants for commercial driver's licenses submit a certificate for completion of such program.

sponsored.t: Relates to immigration status of registered students
sponsored.sum: Mandates that no employee or officer of the university shall determine the specific details of a student's immigration status except when required by federal law, pursuant to a court order or as required in connection with tuition or financial aid eligibility.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the reissuance of certain benefits in instances of fraud or theft of benefits
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the reissuance of emergency assistance to needy families with children, safety net assistance, SNAP benefits, or emergency assistance for aged, blind and disabled persons in instances of fraud or theft of benefits.

sponsored.t: Requires public officers and bodies to provide interpreters and assistive listening devices for the hearing impaired at public hearings under certain conditions
sponsored.sum: Requires public officers and public bodies to make reasonable efforts to provide qualified interpreters at no charge for the hearing impaired at public meetings and hearings upon written request to the public officer responsible for the siting of such hearing; requires installation and use of assistive listening devices.

sponsored.t: Relates to sex trafficking
sponsored.sum: Increases the penalty of sex trafficking and sex trafficking of a child from a class B felony to a class A-II felony.

sponsored.t: Prohibits state contracts with contractors who do not provide health insurance which covers services for transgender, non-binary, and gender expansive people
sponsored.sum: Prohibits state contracts with contractors who do not provide health insurance which covers services for transgender, non-binary, and gender expansive people.

sponsored.t: Requires the chief administrator of the courts to provide certain reports related to the office of court administration
sponsored.sum: Requires the chief administrator of the courts to provide reports on legal training programs conducted by the office of court administration, the performance of the judges and justices of the unified court system, and the security of the judicial and non-judicial officers of the unified court system.

sponsored.t: Relates to the disclosure of law enforcement disciplinary records
sponsored.sum: Requires the disclosure of certain information when an agency responds to a request for law enforcement disciplinary records, including information a victim alleges regarding sexual misconduct.

sponsored.t: Establishes confirmatory adoptions providing for the adoption of children born as a result of assisted reproduction and allows courts to grant custody and support of children from more than two parents; repealer
sponsored.sum: Establishes confirmatory adoptions providing for the adoption of children born as a result of assisted reproduction; allows for more than two persons to be named parents of a child; establishes presumed parentage and provides for the challenge and adjudication thereof; repeals certain provisions relating thereto.

sponsored.t: Enacts the HOPE pilot program; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Enacts the HOPE pilot program; allows households to apply for multiple food and anti-poverty benefits simultaneously online; enables families to work with nonprofit and government agencies to enact action plans to boost their long-term self-sufficiency.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a uterine fibroids awareness and education program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a uterine fibroids awareness and education program on the symptoms, diagnosis and treatment of uterine fibroids and the elevated risk for minority women.

sponsored.t: Expands eligibility for tax abatement for rent-controlled and rent regulated property occupied by persons with disabilities
sponsored.sum: Expands eligibility for tax abatement for rent-controlled and rent regulated property occupied by persons with disabilities to include individuals who do not meet the non-medical qualifications for SSDI and SSI but, by reason of the individual's disability, the individual is not able to engage in substantial gainful activity as that term is defined by the federal social security administration.

sponsored.t: Establishes a clinical preceptorship personal income tax credit for certain health care professionals who provide preceptor instruction to students
sponsored.sum: Establishes a clinical preceptorship personal income tax credit for certain health care professionals who provide preceptor instruction to students studying to be a health care professional.

sponsored.t: Relates to funds received pursuant to a New York opioid settlement sharing agreement
sponsored.sum: Relates to reporting on funds received pursuant to a New York opioid settlement sharing agreement.

sponsored.t: Establishes "SNAP for all", a state-funded supplemental nutrition assistance program to provide for the state's immigrant population
sponsored.sum: Establishes "SNAP for all", a state-funded supplemental nutrition assistance program to provide for those who are excluded from federal SNAP benefits solely due to immigration status; outlines eligibility requirements of applicants and operational requirements of the office of temporary and disability assistance.

sponsored.t: Establishes the green accessible transition authority and establishes a for-hire vehicle improvement surcharge; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes the green transition authority to promote the transition of the for-hire vehicle and other state industries to environmentally sustainable practices and increase universal accessibility of for-hire vehicles, paratransit services, and taxi services statewide; establishes a for-hire vehicle improvement surcharge for each for-hire transportation trip conducted in a transportation network company vehicle or by a high-volume for-hire service; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Adds hazardous air quality to the state definition of a disaster and includes air quality emergency preparedness in local comprehensive emergency management plans
sponsored.sum: Adds hazardous air quality to the state definition of a disaster; requires explicit inclusion of air quality emergency preparedness in local comprehensive emergency management plans with an action plan and annual inventory of air quality emergency resources.

sponsored.t: Requires or allows licensing entities to suspend business licenses for certain businesses that are charged or convicted of wage theft
sponsored.sum: Requires or allows licensing entities to suspend business licenses for certain businesses that are charged or convicted of wage theft; establishes reporting requirements for wage theft convictions.

sponsored.t: Establishes the healthy and safe students act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the healthy and safe students act; requires comprehensive sexuality instruction for students in grades K-12 which includes a model curricula for comprehensive sexuality education and at a minimum conforms to the content and scope of national sexuality education standards.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the reissuance of SNAP benefits in instances of fraud or theft of such benefits
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the reissuance of SNAP benefits in instances of fraud or theft of such benefits.

sponsored.t: Relates to insurance coverage of certain procedures to detect breast cancer
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance coverage of sonograms and other diagnostic procedures used to detect breast cancer for covered persons with a prior history of breast cancer or who have a first degree relative with a prior history of breast cancer.

sponsored.t: Strengthens protections for patients regarding sexual misconduct by medical providers
sponsored.sum: Strengthens protections for patients regarding sexual misconduct by medical providers; requires medical expert consultants involved in investigations disclose conflicts of interest and to not be under investigation, on warning, or on probation; requires a zero-tolerance policy to be adopted and training to be provided on sexual misconduct by the board for professional misconduct; includes provisions related to the right to have a chaperone; includes sexual misconduct in the definition of professional misconduct.

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner to incorporate measures of racial and socioeconomic integration into state accountability models
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner to incorporate measures of racial and socioeconomic integration into state accountability models; requires data compiled to be included in the school report card created by the department.

sponsored.t: Requires schools to include instruction on the prevention of eating disorders as an integral part of their health education programs
sponsored.sum: Requires schools to include instruction on the prevention of eating disorders as an integral part of their health education programs.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the use of closed-circuit television for vulnerable sexual assault witnesses
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the use of closed-circuit television for vulnerable sexual assault witnesses; establishes a procedure for determining who qualifies as a vulnerable sexual assault witness.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a commission for the educational advancement of multilingual learners in New York
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing a commission for the educational advancement of multilingual learners in New York; provides such commission shall report on the best practices and legislative recommendations to close the achievement gap and high school graduation rates between multilingual learners and their English proficient peers from prekindergarten through twelfth grade.

sponsored.t: Establishes the public water justice act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the public water justice act; prohibits sale of waters of the state unless otherwise specifically authorized; establishes a public water justice fund for royalties and fees collected from persons or entities authorized to sell waters of the state.

sponsored.t: Provides a tax credit for the installation of fire sprinkler systems
sponsored.sum: Provides a tax credit for the installation of fire sprinkler systems.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of education to report information regarding counselors, social workers and psychologists in schools
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of education to report information regarding counselors, social workers and psychologists in schools and to implement a plan to increase the school counselor, school social worker and school psychologist to student ratio to nationally accepted standards and provide funding for such.

sponsored.t: Relates to the establishment of a healthy birth grant demonstration program; excludes healthy birth grants from income for certain purposes
sponsored.sum: Relates to the establishment of a healthy birth grant demonstration program; excludes healthy birth grants from income for certain purposes.

sponsored.t: Requires emergency alerts to be issued in the ten most commonly spoken languages in the area covered by such emergency alert
sponsored.sum: Requires emergency alerts to be issued in the ten most commonly spoken languages in the area covered by such emergency alert.

sponsored.t: Extends the authority and oversight of wage boards to include benefits and working conditions and changes the reference to such boards as workers' boards
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority and oversight of wage boards to include the consideration of minimum standards for benefits and working conditions; changes the reference to such boards as workers' boards.

sponsored.t: Allows discretion in requiring sex offender registration for persons convicted of certain sex offenses in other states
sponsored.sum: Allows discretion in requiring sex offender registration for persons convicted of certain sex offenses in other states; amends the definition of a sexually violent offense.

sponsored.t: Requires each institution within the state university of New York and the city university of New York to have at least one vending machine making emergency contraception available for purchase
sponsored.sum: Requires each institution within the state university of New York and the city university of New York offering in-person student instruction to have at least one vending machine making emergency contraception available for purchase.

sponsored.t: Establishes a specialized health home program to serve certain individuals with physical disabilities
sponsored.sum: Establishes a specialized health home program to serve certain individuals with physical disabilities who are Medicaid eligible adults eighteen years of age or older with a diagnosis of a neurological, muscular, or neuromuscular condition, and a mobility impairment; provides that a specialized health home shall be reimbursed on a fee-for-service basis and shall receive enhanced rates of payment; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Establishes the community disaster relief and recovery act of 2025
sponsored.sum: Establishes the community disaster relief and recovery act which will create an emergency assistance program for undocumented individuals impacted by a natural disaster.

sponsored.t: Requires insurance coverage for inhalers at no cost
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance coverage for one rescue and one maintenance inhaler at no cost.

sponsored.t: Creates a department of health education and outreach program on reproductive health services
sponsored.sum: Creates a department of health education and outreach program on reproductive health services for consumers, patients, educators, and health care providers related to reproductive health services available in New York state including, but not limited to: access to family planning services such as contraceptives and pregnancy testing, testing and treatment for sexually transmitted infections; makes related provisions.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 41 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bills: Assembly Bill Number 778-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to directing the department of health to create an informational pamphlet concern- ing intrauterine devices" Assembly Bill Number 2168, entitled: "An ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to requiring the department of health to develop and maternal health care providers to distribute written information about episiotomy to maternity patients" Assembly Bill Number 2581-B, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to the creation of a women's and reproductive health services education and outreach program" TO THE SENATE: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Senate Bill Number 1720, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public health law, in…

sponsored.t: Defines enforcement officers in N.Y. City for the purposes of regulating tobacco products, herbal cigarettes and smoking paraphernalia
sponsored.sum: Defines enforcement officers in a city with a population of one million or more for the purposes of regulating tobacco products, herbal cigarettes and smoking paraphernalia; provides that an enforcement officer for purposes of section 1399-ee of the public health law shall be the office of administrative trials and hearings.

sponsored.t: Relates to the collection of certain demographic information by certain state agencies, boards, departments and commissions
sponsored.sum: Requires separate collection categories for Middle Eastern and North African groups in NYS.
